from pathlib import Path
programs = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u042/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path = programs/'task-6814592a.py'
code = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full-width/full-height lines mark the repeated cell separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    row_starts = [0] + [r + 1 for r in sep_rows]
    row_ends = sep_rows + [h]
    col_starts = [0] + [c + 1 for c in sep_cols]
    col_ends = sep_cols + [w]
    # The first nonempty tile outside the left-hand sample column is the shape stencil.
    stencil = None
    for ri, (rs, re) in enumerate(zip(row_starts, row_ends)):
        for ci, (cs, ce) in enumerate(zip(col_starts, col_ends)):
            if ci == 0:
                continue
            pts = [(r-rs, c-cs) for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cs, ce) if grid[r][c] != 0]
            if pts:
                color = grid[rs + pts[0][0]][cs + pts[0][1]]
                stencil = (re-rs, ce-cs, color, pts)
                break
        if stencil:
            break
    sh, sw, stencil_color, pts = stencil
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in sep_rows:
        out[r] = list(grid[r])
    for c in sep_cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = grid[r][c]
    for rs, re in zip(row_starts, row_ends):
        anchor = [grid[r][c] for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(col_starts[0], col_ends[0]) if grid[r][c] != 0]
        color = anchor[0]
        for cs, ce in zip(col_starts, col_ends):
            for dr, dc in pts:
                out[rs + dr][cs + dc] = color
    return out
'''
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
